newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan interbank rate ends higher on bank issue.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan interbank rate ends higher on bank issue.

text.p: Taiwan's interbank rate finished sharply higher on Tuesday following the central bank's issue of T$12 billion in negotiable certificates of deposit to mop up excess liquidity, dealers said.
The overnight interbank rate ended at 5.039 percent against Monday's 4.958 close, with 30-day commercial paper at 4.95-5.00 percent against 5.00.
The central bank had said on Monday it would seek to keep the rates above the five-percent level.
The bond market did not see transactions in the afternoon. The 10-year 86/4 bond yield was at 6.1000 percent against 6.0950 after morning trade.
